name: polymarket-copy-bot
description: Copies a Polymarket International wallet's sports trades onto a Polymarket US account (DRY_RUN by default).

scripts.dry: cross-env NTFY_TOPIC= ADDED_FUNDS_USD=0 DRY_RUN=true tsx src/index.ts
